properties.title: Andes-virus cluster — MV Hondius cruise (South Atlantic), multi-country
properties.location: MV Hondius; met by CDC at Las Palmas, Canary Islands (2026-05-07); passengers under monitoring across United Kingdom, France, Spain, United States, Argentina, Chile
properties.summary: 12 confirmed and 1 probable/inconclusive Andes-virus cases on the MV Hondius, departed Ushuaia, Argentina on 2026-04-01 with stops in Antarctica, South Georgia Island, Tristan da Cunha, Saint Helena, Ascension Island. CDC met the ship at Las Palmas, Canary Islands on 2026-05-07. 3 deaths reported. Andes virus is the only hantavirus with documented person-to-person transmission.
